findings.detail: C04 treats L.P. interests as equity rows requiring shares even though the source schedule prints a dash in the Principal / Shares column for those L.P. interest rows.

rationale: The C04 metric is low because not every equity-class row has a numeric Principal / Shares value. Raw source table 38 confirms the column is Principal / Shares and shows numeric shares for preferred/common stock rows, but the Firebird L.P. Interest rows show a dash in that same column. This means the missing share values are source-absent for L.P. interests rather than extraction defects in the holdings data, so the C04 flag is a rule-scope false alarm for this filing.
